ops.details: Extract the cohesive set of methods that perform CSS/XPath selection and collection into a new class org.jsoup.nodes.ElementSelector. The moved methods are all Element instance methods that directly call Selector.*, Collector.*, and Regex.compile(...). The new ElementSelector will hold the implementation of these methods (accepting an Element instance as the context where needed). Element retains small delegating methods (or updated callers) that forward to ElementSelector so the public API is preserved. The extraction moves all imports and direct usages of Selector, Collector, and Regex from Element into ElementSelector.

ops.details: Update internal call sites so that any previous direct calls in Element to methods moved into ElementSelector now delegate through ElementSelector (e.g., Element.select(query) -> ElementSelector.select(this, query)). Ensure implementations that previously used Collector.collect(...) and Selector.select(...) are fully moved into ElementSelector; any calls within Element to these behaviors are replaced with delegation. Preserve original method signatures on Element where possible by implementing thin delegating methods that call ElementSelector, so external callers are unaffected.
